---
title: "Bro-oc-co-li, po-o-ta-toes, e-e-e-e-e-e-eggs"
tags: vegetarian
threads: 2
time: 60
---

A complete hot winter meal. [Better than a vocal warmup](https://harisont.github.io/assets/audio/broccoli.mp3).

## Ingredients

- broccoli
- potatoes
- hard cheese, preferably grana
- breadcrumbs
- oil
- salt
- pepper
- eggs

## Equipment

- oven
- microwave (optional, but it speeds things up significantly)
- microwave- and oven safe bowl
- grater

## Steps

1. pre-heat the oven at 200 C
2. - 1. wash, peel and cut the potatoes into bite sized pieces (if you don't want to throw away the peel, [try turning into a snack while the oven is still hot!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=srkg2KQpgr8&t=177s))
     2. put the potatoes in a bowl and microwave them for about 5 minutes. If you don't have a microwave, boil them until they start to soften slightly
   - wash and cut the broccoli head into pieces of about the same size of the potato bits
3. add the broccoli to the bowl and microwave everything for another 5-10 minutes. If you don't have a microwave, you can skip this step
4. grate an abundance of the cheese into a smaller bowl
5. mix the cheese with the same amount of breadcrumbs
6. add the mixture to the larger bowl and add some oil, salt and pepper. Mix everything together.
7. move the bowl into the oven.
8. - let it bake until the potatoes are soft and breadcrumbs have browned (the amount of time this takes varies depending on whether or not the vegetables have been microwaved). At some point in the process, take the bowl out of the oven and mix
   - snack on broccoli stem
9. - take the bowl out of the oven and let it cool down slightly
   - fry one egg per person
10. plate the vegetables with an egg on top, dressing with some more salt and pepper

pink-fluid-(aka-red-beet-soup).recipe:
---
title: Pink Fluid (aka red beet soup)
tags: vegetarian, vegan
threads: 2
time: 60
---

With adequate toppings, this beet + potato soup can taste pretty good, but the real reason to make it is that looks very pink. That doesn't change if you add carrots to the mix.

## Ingredients
- red beets
- potatoes
- vegetable broth
- onion(s)
- bay leaves
- (olive) oil
- salt
- pepper
- toppings of your choice (recommended: pumpkin seeds and bread croutons)

### Optional
- carrots
- unsweetened yogurt or sour cream
- cheese to grate

## Equipment
- hand blender

## Steps
1. - chop the onion finely and sauté it in some oil inside a tall pot
   - dice the vegetables

2. - add the vegetables to the pot and stir for about 5 minutes
   - warm the broth up

3. - pour the broth into the pot and bring it to a boil. Let everything cook for at least 15-20 minutes, until both the beets and the potatoes are soft
   - grate a generous amount of cheese

4. turn off the stove and blend everything together
5. add toppings and season with salt, pepper and optionally some extra oil and a bit of yogurt or sour cream

---
title: Protest red curry
tags: vegan
threads: 4
time: 45
---

This recipe is the result of me refusing to follow the recipe for a type of curry I wanted to make because I thought it was wrong and hated the website (hence this website). 

## Ingredients
- __red__ lentils
- (basmati) rice
- coconut milk
- vegetable stock cube
- garlic
- tomato paste (which is obviously __red__)
- __red__ (hot) chili peppers
- __red__ (hot) chili pepper powder
- cumin powder
- turmeric powder
- ginger powder (fresh ginger is also ok, of course)
- garam masala
- lemon/lime
- __red__ pepper
- coriander
- oil
- salt

### Optional
- __red__ peppers (or any other greens that are actually __red__)
- tomato puree (which is also obviously __red__)

## Equipment
- wok

## Steps
1. - chop the garlic finely
   - slice the red hot chili pepper(s)
   - dice the peppers or any other vegetables you want to use
   - warm up some oil in the wok
2. - sauté the garlic and chili together with some tomato paste
   - rinse the lentils
   - prepare the vegetable broth (if you are planning to add tomato puree, use very little water)
3. add the vegetables and let them cook for a few minutes
4. pour the coconut milk into the wok
5. - add all the powders
   - stir
6. - add the lentils and let cook on medium-low heat, stirring every now and then. As the mixture dries up, irrigate with broth and, optionally, tomato puree
   - 1. - rinse the rice
        - pour some water (2 units per unit of rice) into a separate pot and bring it to a boil
     2. salt the water and add the rice. Let it cook on low heat until all water has been absorbed, without stirring
7. when the lentils have become soft, turn off the heat
8. add abundant lemon/lime juice and stir
9. season with red pepper and coriander

punsch-ice-cream.recipe:
---
title: Punsch ice cream
tags: dessert, vegetarian
threads: 3
time: 20
---

Note: If you prefer a softer & sweeter ice cream, then use more punsch (liquor) or sugar respectively. If you prefer it more icy and firmer then use less alcohol and sugar. I highly dont recommend going above 1.5 dl liquor as it'll feel like ice cream shots.

## Ingredients

- 5-6 egg yolks
- 0.5-1.5 dl Punsch (liquor)
- 1-3 dl sugar
- 5-6 dl whipping cream

### Optional

- Chocolate

## Equipment

- Electric whisk or anything that whips the cream

## Steps

- Put the **egg yolks** (separate it if you havent done so already) in a bowl then put the sugar in. Whisk it to a smooth texture then add the liquor and mix
- Turn the whipping cream into whipped cream
- Cut the chocolate into tiny pieces

- Mix everything together, optionally save some chocolate to add as sprinkles on top.

- Pour into containers and freeze for minimum 8 hours.
